title: Vector model transition safety net and telemetry contracts
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We need a low-friction path to introduce new embedding model variants while protecting existing customer workloads from quality regressions and unexpected latency/cost changes. Current onboarding playbooks are heavily manual and focus on canaries per-tenant; we lack a standardized telemetry contract and an automated safety net to reduce manual rollbacks.

Goal: Produce a repeatable transition flow and enforcement layer that ensures any new embedding variant meets quality (nDCG/recall thresholds), latency (p99 SLO delta), and cost (tokens/second and per-embedding unit) constraints before traffic is expanded. Provide clear telemetry contracts (signals, thresholds, dashboards) and a lightweight automatic fallback mechanism for early failures.

Scope: This ticket covers the technical design, implementation of telemetry checks, the safety-net automated fallback for the embeddings gateway, and the rollout automation that integrates with our deployment orchestration. It does NOT include long-term policy for deprecated model TTLs or billing adjustments (separate work).

Out-of-scope: embedding evaluation dataset creation (handled by Research team) and dedicated tenant SLA negotiations.

Design constraints and trade-offs: We must avoid increasing steady-state request latency by more than 2ms on the gateway path. Telemetry checks should be efficient — derive signals from existing sampling and traces instead of full offline re-embedding of corpora. For quality signals where realtime labels are unavailable, we will rely on lightweight calibration via precomputed reference vectors plus small production shadow traffic. The fallback mechanism must be per-tenant and allow operator override to prevent repeated flip-flopping.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Telemetry contract doc published and reviewed by Research and Observability teams. 2) Gatekeeper implements three checks (quality delta, latency delta, cost delta) and runs automatically during staged rollout. 3) Automated per-tenant fallback (20% of failures auto-rollback) works in staging and can be toggled via Console. 4) End-to-end test that simulates a poor-quality model triggers the fallback and records expected audit logs. 5) Dashboard with KPIs (nDCG sample, p50/p95/p99 latency, per-embedding unit cost) created and linked in the ticket.
rollout_plan: Phase A (staging): run model variant in shadow mode for 48h with 5% sampled traffic; verify telemetry signals. Phase B (vanguard): enable 5% live traffic split for a cohort of tolerant tenants for 72h. Phase C (ramped): 25% -> 50% -> 100% across weeks with telemetry gates at each step. Safety-net: If any gate fails, the gateway will cut traffic to previous variant for impacted tenants and emit an incident. Manual override through Console allowed with audit trail. Rollouts are performed via the model registry and orchestration endpoint: registry://models/<variant>/releases/<timestamp>.
telemetry_metrics: quality: sampled_nDCG@10 (baseline vs candidate, delta threshold -1.5%), recall@100 at user-query distribution; latency: p50/p95/p99 end-to-end embedding endpoint latency and prefetch KV cache miss delta; cost: avg GPU tokens/sec per request and estimated per-embedding unit cost; reliability: error rate and timeout count. All metrics emitted as tags: model_variant, tenant_id, cohort. Alerting: Pager if quality delta < -2% for 1 hour or p99 latency increases by >30% for 15 minutes.
migration_steps: 1) Add model metadata in registry with compatibility flags (vector-dim, tokenizer hash, normalization strategy). 2) Run synthesis job to build a 10k reference vector set for candidate models and store fingerprints. 3) Deploy candidate as shadow on embeddings gateway with sample rate config. 4) Execute calibration job to compute baseline deltas. 5) Promote to vanguard cohorts via orchestration API. 6) After stable vanguard, run automated ramp and confirm gates. 7) Sunset path: mark legacy model as deprecated with TTL and migration notes in registry.
qa_plan: - Unit tests for telemetry collectors and gate evaluation logic. - Integration tests in staging with a simulated low-quality model to assert fallback. - Load test to ensure steady-state latency overhead <2ms at 95th percentile. - Exploratory QA: run a small tenant group with human-in-the-loop judgment for the first vanguard release. - Post-deploy: 7-day smoke checks and weekly quality audits for 4 weeks.
rollback_plan: Automatic: Gatekeeper flips tenant routing to last-known-good variant and writes audit event; operator page notifies SRE. Manual: Console operator can force immediate switch, with a reason and follow-up tasks auto-created. Rollback will restart at last successful registry-promote timestamp. A rollback postmortem template will be auto-populated with telemetry snapshots and sample queries.
